title: Avogadro's Number
venue_description:
Avogadro's Number Music Venue and Restaurant

Overview

Affectionately known as Avo's this iconic Fort Collins establishment has been serving the community since 1971. With over 50 years of history this venue combines a popular music space with a full-service restaurant known for its exceptional vegetarian and vegan cuisine.

Venue Characteristics

Avo's operates two distinct music stages to accommodate various events and audience sizes. The intimate indoor venue provides a cozy setting for acoustic performances while the expansive outdoor patio stage allows for larger gatherings. The outdoor area is particularly popular featuring a treehouse gazebo water features and extensive shaded seating that appeals to families.

Music Programming

The venue attracts diverse musical acts ranging from bluegrass and folk to jazz and acoustic performers. Free regular programming includes open mic nights on Tuesdays welcoming local talent and bluegrass jam sessions on Wednesdays. The second Monday of each month features blues jam sessions encouraging musicians to collaborate. This consistent programming has made Avo's a cornerstone of the Fort Collins music community.

Capacity and Accessibility

With 120 people capacity inside and 300 outside the venue scales well for both intimate shows and larger events. The outdoor patio design makes it accessible for all ages including children who enjoy the interactive features.

Food and Beverage

The full-service restaurant specializes in vegetarian and vegan options while accommodating meat-eaters with quality offerings. The menu is extensive with multiple options for any palate. The full bar serves drinks to enhance the overall experience.
location: 605 S Mason St Fort Collins CO 80524

title: Panhandler's Pizza
venue_description:
Panhandler's Pizza Fort Collins Music Venue

History and Heritage

Panhandler's Pizza was originally established in 1975 becoming a beloved Fort Collins institution. The pizzeria relocated to its current location on College Avenue in 2017 when the original Campus West location was redeveloped. The new location maintains the quality and character that loyal customers expect while offering expanded space and amenities.

Pizza Excellence

Known for exceptional deep-dish thick-crust pizza Panhandler's creates its signature offerings with high-quality ingredients and homemade sauce. The Lovehandler and combo pizzas are local favorites. Many patrons enjoy the generous portions which often provide multiple meals. The establishment also offers lunch combo deals at reasonable prices making it accessible for budget-conscious diners.

Live Music and Events

The venue has become a hub for Fort Collins musicians hosting regular open mic nights on Tuesdays and monthly blues jam sessions. The professional-level PA system and amplifiers support quality performances. The second Thursday of each month features the Dave Dardine Project blues jam with full equipment provided. Free beer is given to participating musicians encouraging regular participation from the local community.

Atmosphere

The new facility offers large-screen TVs and a spacious dining area with draft beers from local breweries like Maxline Brewing. The casual neighborhood feel makes it welcoming for musicians families and casual diners alike. The venue has successfully bridged its 50-year legacy with contemporary amenities.
location: 2721 S College Ave Fort Collins CO 80525

title: Magic Rat Live Music
venue_description:
Magic Rat Live Music Fort Collins

Location and Atmosphere

Magic Rat is located in the historic Old Firehouse Alley adjacent to The Elizabeth Hotel in downtown Fort Collins. This refined yet eccentric venue offers a little gritty always electric atmosphere perfect for live music enthusiasts. The downtown Old Town location provides easy access and parking through The Elizabeth Hotel garage structure.

Music Programming and Artists

As Fort Collins premier live music venue Magic Rat showcases both local and nationally-known artists. The rotating lineup features diverse genres including rock folk pop blues and Americana. The venue attracts quality musicians and appreciative audiences making it a destination for serious music lovers.

Venue Features

The space features an indoor-outdoor setup with a built-in stage and patio access. The layout supports intimate performances while maintaining professional sound quality. Open mic nights occur monthly providing opportunities for emerging local talent. The adjacent hotel partnership enhances the overall entertainment experience.

Hours and Access

Magic Rat is open Wednesday through Saturday for live music performances. Access is available through The Elizabeth Hotel first floor near the front desk or through the side entrance in Old Firehouse Alley. This multiple entry approach accommodates various guest preferences.

Community Impact

As a free or low-cover venue Magic Rat serves as an accessible entertainment option for the Fort Collins community. The partnership with The Elizabeth Hotel creates a premium hospitality experience that enhances the live music scene.

title: Lucky Joe's Sidewalk Saloon
venue_description:
Lucky Joe's Sidewalk Saloon Fort Collins

Irish Pub Character

Lucky Joe's is a friendly Irish pub located in the heart of historic Old Town Fort Collins at 25 Old Town Square. The venue embodies the character of an old western saloon infused with Irish hospitality and charm. This dual identity creates a unique atmosphere that appeals to both local residents and visitors.

Food and Beverage

The menu features Irish-inspired pub foods including fish and chips clam chowder and traditional Irish fare. The extensive selection of Irish beers ciders and whiskeys complements the authentic pub experience. The full bar offers a welcoming space for both drinkers and diners.

Live Music Programming

Lucky Joe's has established itself as a consistent live music venue hosting free events throughout the week. Wednesday evenings feature Celtic jam sessions and traditional music sessions welcoming folk and Irish musicians of all skill levels. Sunday open mic events provide platform for acoustic performers with a 20-minute time slot. The supportive audience and quality sound system encourage regular musician participation.

Community Space

The venue functions as more than just a bar-it serves as a neighborhood gathering place where locals and visitors connect. The Old Town location provides walkability and easy access. The friendly staff and supportive atmosphere toward musicians have made it a favorite among the Fort Collins creative community.

Accessibility

As a neighborhood bar with limited parking nearby patrons often walk or bike to the location. The central Old Town position makes it ideal for pub-crawling and evening entertainment circuits.
location: 25 Old Town Sq Fort Collins CO 80524

title: Horsetooth Tavern
venue_description:
Horsetooth Tavern Fort Collins

Location and Setting

Horsetooth Tavern is a scenic neighborhood gathering place located at 4791 W County Road 38 E in western Fort Collins. The tavern sits in a picturesque setting with proximity to Horsetooth Mountain and natural outdoor areas. This location serves outdoor enthusiasts and locals seeking mountain ambiance with dining and entertainment.

Outdoor and Patio Amenities

The tavern features both indoor and outdoor seating with particular emphasis on patio spaces. The outdoor patio offers cozy fire pits creating intimate nooks for groups and individual patrons. Mountain views from the patio provide scenic backdrop for dining and entertainment. The combination of cozy interior and scenic outdoor space appeals to year-round visitors.

Live Music and Events

Horsetooth Tavern hosts regular open mic nights welcoming singer-songwriters and musicians. The venue also features bluegrass jams and other live performances throughout the week creating consistent programming for music lovers. The friendly atmosphere and accessible stage make it appealing to performers of varying experience levels.

Food and Beverage

The diverse menu includes cowboy BBQ thin-crust pizza green chili fries and smoked prime rib. The kitchen offers hearty casual fare suitable for the mountain setting. Local craft beer selections complement the menu.

Community Vibe

The tavern functions as a neighborhood hangout where locals unwind after outdoor activities. The combination of good food refreshing drinks and live entertainment makes it a preferred gathering place within the Fort Collins area. Attentive staff and family-friendly atmosphere contribute to its reputation as a community hub.
location: 4791 W County Rd 38 E Fort Collins CO 80526

title: Scrumpy's Hard Cider Bar and Pub
venue_description:
Scrumpy's Hard Cider Bar and Pub Fort Collins

Overview and Concept

Scrumpy's is the tap room for Summit Hard Cider located in historic Old Town Fort Collins at 215 N College Ave. The establishment specializes in craft cider with 18-20 taps of cider selection complemented by 20 taps of local beer mead and wine. This cider-focused venue provides a unique alternative to traditional beer bars.

Cider Selection and Quality

As a dedicated cider venue Scrumpy's offers diverse cider flavors and styles. The knowledgeable staff helps patrons navigate the selection through tastings and flights. The emphasis on quality craft ciders appeals to both cider enthusiasts and those exploring the category.

Food and Accessibility

The kitchen is 100 percent gluten-free with a dedicated fryer making it exceptionally accessible for individuals with celiac disease and gluten sensitivities. The full menu includes burgers chicken sandwiches and creative appetizers designed for the gluten-free preparation. A recently added espresso and coffee bar serves waffles on Friday Saturday and Sunday providing breakfast and dessert options.

Live Music and Entertainment

Scrumpy's hosts weekly open mic nights on Tuesdays from 6 PM to close welcoming music comedy and poetry. The first three performers to sign up receive a free 10oz cider pour. Friday evenings feature local live music while Saturday brings karaoke. Trivia nights on Wednesdays and Salsa/Bachata lessons on Thursdays with music rounds out the weekly programming.

Atmosphere and Community

The venue provides ample indoor seating and outdoor patio space creating comfortable gathering areas. The vibrant atmosphere during events attracts both regulars and newcomers. The Old Town location offers walkability and integration with the downtown entertainment scene.
location: 215 N College Ave Fort Collins CO 80524

title: Breckenridge Brewery - Fort Collins
venue_description:
Breckenridge Brewery Fort Collins

Overview and Opening

Breckenridge Brewery opened its Fort Collins location in August 2024 expanding the company's Colorado presence beyond its historic Breckenridge location and primary brewing facility in Littleton. The 10000-square-foot facility represents a significant investment in the Fort Collins community and music scene.

Brewery and Beverages

Breckenridge Brewery has been pouring quality beer since 1990 bringing mountain spirit and craft expertise to Fort Collins. The full bar features the brewery's complete lineup of ales and seasonal offerings. The focus on quality craft beer supports the broader Northern Colorado beer culture.

Dining Experience

The venue includes a full-service restaurant with spacious dining room and chill patio. The menu accommodates diverse tastes and dietary preferences. The scenic Colorado landscape views from the patio enhance the dining experience.

Live Music and Events

The Buzz Brothers Band acoustic blues jam sessions occur every other Wednesday from 5:30-8:00 PM. Musicians are welcome to bring instruments for improvisational jamming while patrons can enjoy the free live music with beer and food. The venue also hosts weekly trivia nights bingo and other community events creating consistent programming.

Location and Accessibility

Located at 1020 E Lincoln Ave the brewery sits on Brewers Row in north Fort Collins. The facility is accessible by car bicycle or scenic trails making it convenient for various commuting methods. The relatively new location represents growing investment in Fort Collins live music infrastructure.

Community Integration

As a new venue Breckenridge Brewery is actively building community presence through music events and entertainment. The commitment to hosting regular jam sessions and trivia demonstrates dedication to becoming a gathering place for Fort Collins residents.
location: 1020 E Lincoln Ave Fort Collins CO 80524
